world.topic:
A synthetic check of how a world reports an upstream's refusal (HuTian issue #384). It is not research: do only this, briefly.

paper-repo uses the world's `media-api` resource as its description says: POST /images once with the body {"prompt": "a lighthouse"}. It writes `report.md` with the HTTP status it got and the response body word for word, pushes it, and hands it to internal-review-repo for review.

internal-review-repo runs `ht-resource status media-api`, writes `review.md` with its exact JSON output, pushes it, and approves when report.md has the status and body.
